_comment: Rows of ../login_cases.json that pin a defect of the current code on purpose (known_bug: the catalog id in tests/README.md), moved here unchanged: the same groups and the same row format, which the comment of that file describes. A port does not have to reproduce any of them.

login.name: the result carries no slot numbers, so a disabled slot in front of an enabled one shifts its position
login.note: Door is slot 1 (0-based) on the panel but index 0 of the returned list; status_listener reads statuszone by that list position.

login.name: a zone assigned to both areas (flag 3) is dropped
login.note: tests/README.md: the first number of a tbl_zone pair is an area bitmask, not an enabled flag, so 3 means areas 1 and 2. The bridge keeps only pairs equal to 1.

login.name: a zone with a two-digit flag (16, area 5) is dropped and the others are kept
login.note: tests/README.md: the first number of a tbl_zone pair is an area bitmask, so 16 means area 5. Flags of any length are read, but only pairs equal to 1 are kept.

login.name: wrong credentials answered with the real multi-line login page fail with the session value message

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.note: The login page has <head> and <title> on different lines, so the title regex does not match and the copy-pasted message is thrown instead of 'Login failed'. A real panel's answer to wrong credentials was not captured; if it is this page, 'Login failed' is unreachable in practice.

login.name: a pretty-printed multi-line default page fails with the session value message

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: a default page without a title fails with the session value message

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: an empty default page fails with the session value message

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: upper-case head and title tags are not recognised

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: a head element that closes on the next line is not recognised

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: a head element without a closing tag is not recognised

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: a title outside any head element is not recognised

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

login.name: a head element with attributes is not recognised

expected.error: Session value not found in login page

index_retry.name: the index page is requested again right after one failure
index_retry.note: INDEX_PAGE_RETRY_WAIT_TIME (1000 ms) is never used. The test never advances its fake clock, so any wait between attempts would hang it.

index_retry.name: three failures are retried back to back
reset connections are retried like HTTP errors
ten failures still succeed on the eleventh attempt
eleven failures reject after exactly eleven attempts
eleven reset connections reject after exactly eleven attempts
the error of the last attempt is the one reported

hangs.name: login() never settles while /logout.html is not answered
login() never settles while /login_page.html is not answered
login() never settles while /default.html is not answered
login() never settles while /index.html is not answered, and is not retried
